title: Spicy Thai Skewers
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai recipe featuring marinated beef skewers grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of sticky rice and your favorite Thai sauces.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together curry paste, fish sauce, brown sugar, and vegetable oil.
2. Add beef strips to the marinade and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
4. Thread beef strips onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Brush skewers with oil and season with salt.
6. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until beef is cooked to desired level of doneness.
7. Transfer skewers to a serving platter and garnish with cilantro.
8. Serve with sticky rice and lime wedges on the side.
